_comment: What scripts/build-sw.py needs to know about this course. The generator
is the same file in all seven repositories on shamsfelfel.github.io;
everything that differs between them is here. See the header of
scripts/build-sw.py for every key. It replaced scripts/build-sw.js,
which did this job in Node for this one repository.
data/ is deliberately absent. Every case snapshot in it is also embedded
in assets/js/data.js by scripts/build-data.js, which is what the widget
reads; the JSON files are only fetched when a page is served without
data.js, so precaching them would download twenty-three files twice.
note:
Every page, stylesheet, script, font, icon and the vendored SQL engine,
precached on install, so the lab runs with the network off and installs
as an app on Windows, Android and iOS.
